title: Beautiful ModPack
description: This is a modpack designed to add optimization's to the game & make it look cooler via shaders and mods.
body:
# The Beautiful Modpack

Minecraft is already a great game — but with the right mods, it can feel like a completely different experience. That's exactly what The Beautiful Modpack is going for.

## ✨ Better Visuals

Full shader support via **Iris**, dynamic lighting that actually reacts to torches and glowing items thanks to **LambDynamicLights**, seamless connected textures with **Continuity**, and 3D player skin layers that make everyone look just a little more alive. It's the same Minecraft you know, just... prettier.

## ⚡ Serious Performance

Nobody wants a beautiful game that runs at 30fps. **Sodium, Lithium, Krypton, FerriteCore, C2ME,** and a handful of other optimisation mods are all working quietly in the background to keep things fast and smooth — even on mid-range hardware.

## 🛠️ Quality of Life

The small stuff matters. **JEI** so you never forget a recipe. **Jade** so you always know what you're looking at. **Controlling** so your keybinds don't become a nightmare. **Chat Heads** because it's just a nice touch. It all adds up.

## 🎨 A Fresh Coat of Paint

From the moment you boot the game, things feel a bit more polished. Custom menus, a cleaner loading screen, and a reimagined intro make the whole experience feel intentional — not like a random collection of mods thrown together.
